long_biography.plain_text:
Resource investing grew out of technical work for Baker. He studied mineral processing and production management at Imperial College London, then began as a metallurgist at CRA’s Broken Hill operation. Mining-analyst posts in Sydney and London led to Merrill Lynch Investment Management. There he joined the natural-resources team and ran the Mercury Gold Metal Open Fund from launch until his 2001 departure.

That year, Baker and Trevor Steel formed an independently owned investment manager built around metals and mining expertise. Baker led its Sydney operation and became a longstanding managing partner, applying geological and valuation analysis to listed and private resource companies. His formal control reduced in 2025, when he ended a directorship and ceased to be registered as a significant controller. Baker nevertheless continues with the firm as a partner and special adviser. Its strategies remain concentrated on natural resources, gold and precious-metals equities.
